description: This Java class defines a GUI toolbar component for interfacing with table data in the RomRaider application. It includes buttons and controls for adjusting table values, visualizing 3D data, coloring cells, and managing scales, tailored for specific table interactions within the software. It leverages Swing components for UI elements and interacts with table data structures.

classes.name: TableToolBar
classes.description: A Swing toolbar component for interacting with table data, providing controls to modify scale, values, and visualize 3D data.

methods.name: updateIcons
methods.description: Rescales toolbar button icons based on user settings.

methods.name: rescaleImageIcon
methods.description: Rescales an ImageIcon to a specified scale percentage.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected table from the UI.

methods.name: updateTableToolBar
methods.description: Updates toolbar state based on the selected table.

methods.name: updateTableToolBar
methods.description: Overloaded method to update toolbar with a specific table instance.

methods.name: updateToolbarIncrementDecrementValues
methods.description: Updates the increment/decrement controls to reflect current table scale increments.

methods.name: toggleTableToolBar
methods.description: Enables or disables toolbar controls depending on table selection and type.

methods.name: setScales
methods.description: Populates scale selection combo box with available scales.

methods.name: mouseClicked
methods.description: Handles mouse click events on toolbar buttons, performing corresponding actions.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a table cell's value based on input field.

methods.name: multiply
methods.description: Multiplies the selected table's values by a specified factor.

methods.name: incrementFine
methods.description: Increments table values by a fine adjustment.

methods.name: decrementFine
methods.description: Decrements table values by a fine adjustment.

methods.name: incrementCoarse
methods.description: Increments table values by a coarse adjustment.

methods.name: decrementCoarse
methods.description: Decrements table values by a coarse adjustment.

methods.name: enable3d
methods.description: Launches a 3D graph visualization for the table data.

methods.name: colorCells
methods.description: Colors table cells according to their values.

methods.name: refreshCompare
methods.description: Refreshes comparison table data.

methods.name: setCoarseValue
methods.description: Sets the coarse adjustment value.

methods.name: setFineValue
methods.description: Sets the fine adjustment value.

methods.name: focusSetValue
methods.description: Focuses input on the set value text field.

methods.name: newGraphData
methods.description: Callback for updating table data from 3D graph interactions.

methods.name: selectStateChange
methods.description: Callback for selection state changes in 3D graph.
